title: Yuanda: werewolf ambush
summary: Survive five werewolves and follow the trail to the shady bandit.
overview: A necromancer at the appropriate pre-epic stage can give Yuanda the note to summon four regular werewolves and one stronger werewolf.
The stronger wolf increases its maximum melee hit at 75%, 50% and 25% health. Defeating all five wolves summons the shady bandit for the next step.
The wolves have a 30-minute despawn timer that is not paused in combat.

phases.label: Werewolf ambush
phases.description: Control all five wolves and prepare for the stronger wolf to hit harder at each health threshold.

phases.label: Follow the trail
phases.description: Find the newly spawned shady bandit to continue the quest.

sections.title: Starting the ambush
paragraphs: The necromancer must have the matching recorded pre-epic stage.
